scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Dart Flutter client (pyric_functions) conforming to cloud_functions via the Pyric Functions HTTP gateway and WebSocket bridge. Covers FirebaseFunctions.instance and instanceFor(app:, region:), useFunctionsEmulator, httpsCallable and httpsCallableFromUrl/httpsCallableFromUri routing with off-machine refusal, v2 onCall and v1 https.onCall invocation, 64-bit int and BigInt Int64Value/UInt64Value serialization, Auth Bearer and standard or limited-use X-Firebase-AppCheck header propagation, sealed StreamResponse (Chunk and Result) SSE streaming, FirebaseFunctionsException mapping, and timeout/dispose cancellation.
